title: SAFEEVALAGENT: TOWARD AGENTIC AND SELF-EVOLVING SAFETY EVALUATION OF LLMS
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. Its focus is on safety and compliance with legal and regulatory frameworks like the EU AI Act, the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, and the Monetary Authority of Singapore's FEAT principles.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it was not a focus of the study.
